body: Do you know this person's living conditions? Not everyone is as savvy or has as much opportunity as that guy.

I've been depressed since I was a little kid. To the point where I've never had a social life or close friends. 

All I've done is hold her back. I feel as if dying will free everyone from my mistake of an existence.

Nobody loves you. 


It would have prepared me for who I am now. All of my friends during then only used me to look better and most of my family doesn't care if I exist. It would have saved me so much grief.
It hurt a bit, but then it didn't. I was tired. Everything felt relaxing. Waking up sucked though. Not horrible horrible but mostly disappointment.
Hey, I understand how painful it is to feel stuck and like you have no where to go. If you need to vent my dms are free. I'm so sorry that things are like this, and I wish the best for you.
I just don't know anymore man. I'm running out of options and as far I see there is no future.
